args.lesson: PURSUE_IF. The official Shopify guide, unlike Manager's, specifies the variant row layout well enough to deliver over plain text. Converting a flat variant list to Shopify layout passed 12/12 synthetic checks, and bad input gave 3 explicit errors. Worked: stripping the page to text once and writing checks separately from the transformer. Gaps: Matrixify returned 403 (no demand or paid-alternative evidence); the guide doesn't say whether option names repeat; no Shopify import was run. I caught a 200-row price scope that a 20-row channel can't deliver. Next: check price scope against channel limits, get demand evidence before any public offer, and wait until the CSV window closes on 2026-11-19.
